name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-10-28, at wavelengths from 1.20 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
